tasks.title: Fix ScInit MCP Tool Schema
tasks.description: Remove extra HashMap from ScInit in src/mcp/server.rs so rust-mcp-sdk derives clean JSON Schema with name as required, and domain, description, mode as optional.

tasks.title: Implement Domain Auto-Discovery in SpecConfig
tasks.description: In SpecConfig::load_config in src/manager/spec_manager.rs, auto-discover domain directories in projects/completed/ matching '\d{2}_.*' when domains list is empty or .spec.json is absent.

tasks.title: Add set_domain, get_domain, and list_domains in SpecManager
tasks.description: Implement SpecManager methods to mutate .spec-meta.json and update .epoch-context.md with the newly assigned domain for active features, and list all known domains.

tasks.title: Wire CLI Domain Subcommands
tasks.description: Add Commands::Domain with Set, Get, and List actions in src/cli/commands.rs and dispatch them in src/main.rs.

tasks.title: Expose sc_domain MCP Tool
tasks.description: Define ScDomain tool struct in src/mcp/server.rs, add to tools/list, and handle tool execution in handle_call_tool_request.

tasks.title: Unit and Integration Tests
tasks.description: Add tests in tests/mcp_test.rs verifying sc_init schema cleanliness and sc_domain execution, and in tests/workflow_test.rs verifying post-init domain setting and auto-discovery archival.

tasks.title: Documentation, Version Bump (v0.1.20), and Release Verification
tasks.description: Bump Cargo.toml to 0.1.20, update README.md and SC_INIT_GUIDE.md, run full test suite, and prepare release steps for crates.io and local installation.
